baseline: 8px. Every gap, pad and offset is a multiple. --space-half (4px) is the sole exception, for optical alignment against a 1px hairline.

archive.use: Editorial and print. Fichas, posters, packaging, the folio system. Air is the point.

field.use: Reports, labels, lot records, SOPs. The default mode.

control.use: Dense telemetry. Dashboards, metric tables, room monitors.

structure.shadow: none — the only legal value. Depth is expressed with rules, never blur.
